instruction: A robotic spider cast entirely in flowing liquid chrome, its mirror-smooth teardrop body suspended on eight jointed pin-tipped legs. The reflective surface warps the surrounding environment into streaks of silver, and beaded droplet accents seem to bead and roll along the polished limbs.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Chrome Spider Bot in a liquid-chrome style. A robotic spider cast entirely in flowing liquid chrome, its mirror-smooth teardrop body suspended on eight jointed pin-tipped legs. The reflective surface warps the surrounding environment into streaks of silver, and beaded droplet accents seem to bead and roll along the polished limbs. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
